title: He Checked Three Times. Then This Happened.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: [slow, storytelling] Phil Ivey checked to her... three times.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: She had aces up. So she bet a hundred and twenty-five thousand.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: Ivey raises first to act. She calls on the button... with ace-queen suited.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: The flop. Eight. Eight. Ace. Two pair. She bets fifty thousand... and Ivey just calls.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: River. A nine. And Ivey checks... again.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: Three checks. He has to be weak... right? She bets a hundred and twenty-five thousand.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: [dramatic] And Ivey check-raises... to four hundred and fifty thousand.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: She uses three time-bank chips. She only needs to be right twenty-nine percent of the time.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: [slow] Pocket aces. Ivey flopped a full house... and checked it three times.

lines.speaker: n
lines.text: When a great player goes quiet... then explodes on the river... believe him.
